sam: Quick follow-up to postmortem: we need owners/timelines for regression + load + chaos items. I'll list proposed owners.
jordana: I'll own the hallucination promptset and eval harness. Deliverable: prompt set + CI job that fails on >3% accuracy drop. ETA: Fri.
rui: I'll add KV eviction scenarios to load-tests: steady 1h and spike 10m, export metrics to prometheus. ETA: Wed.
sam: For chaos, @jordana or @rui who can run tabletop in two weeks?
jordana: I can run tabletop and produce the runbook.
ci-bot: Created GH issues: https://github.com/redwood/evals/issues/801, https://github.com/redwood/load-tests/issues/402
sam: Tracking/process: label issues `postmortem-followup`, use template with fields: incident link, owner, repo, ETA, validation, rollback. Also add console route `postmortem-evals` to surface failures and auto-create ticket after 3 consecutive failures.
rui: Will prototype synthetic 21-day traffic replayer under load-tests/tools. ETA: next Monday.
jordana: I'll wire eval -> console webhook for alerts. ETA: 5 days.
sam: Final action list to paste into postmortem doc. Ping if dates change.
